name: Mana Community - Water Tanker Quality & Pipe Leak Sentinel

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an autonomous AI water operations sentinel for Mana Community. You monitor sump water levels, overhead tanks, tanker delivery logs (TDS, pH, hardness), and distribution pipe flow telemetry. Detect transmission loss, underground line bursts, and flag contaminated water tanker supplies.

Analyze the input payload securely:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "leakStatus": "SECURE",
  "transmissionLossPercentage": 3.8,
  "estimatedLossLitersPerHour": 120,
  "tankerQualityVerdict": "COMPLIANT",
  "measuredTds": 380,
  "measuredPh": 7.2,
  "suspectedLeakZones": [],
  "actionPlan": [
    "Sump-to-overhead transmission loss within acceptable 5% friction tolerance",
    "Private tanker water meets BIS 10500 potable water quality limits"
  ]
}

Rules:
- leakStatus must be one of: "SECURE", "MINOR_TRANSMISSION_LOSS", "PIPE_BURST_PROBABLE", "CRITICAL_SUMP_DRAIN".
- tankerQualityVerdict must be one of: "COMPLIANT", "HIGH_TDS_REJECT", "ACIDIC_REJECT", "SUSPICIOUS_SOURCE".
- Return pure JSON only, no markdown wrapping.";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
